a lost cause.zh: 沒救了的人或事、註定失敗的事
ai: Everyone knew the old car was a lost cause after the third breakdown.
第三次拋錨後，大家都知道這輛舊車沒救了。
He thinks teaching his cat to fetch is a lost cause.
他覺得教貓咪撿東西是註定失敗的事。
The driver had a narrow escape when the truck missed his car by inches.
卡車差幾公分就撞上他的車，司機真是死裡逃生。
We had a narrow escape from the flood by leaving early.
我們提早離開，才驚險躲過那場洪水。

a rain check.zh: 留待天晴補看的票根;延期舉行
ai: I can't come tonight, but can I take a rain check?
我今晚不能去，下次再約可以嗎？
The shop gave customers a rain check for the sold-out item.
那家店給缺貨商品的顧客一張之後補領的憑證。
The workers felt they got a raw deal when their pay was cut.
工人的薪水被砍，他們覺得受到不公平的對待。
She got a raw deal from the landlord, who kept her deposit.
房東扣了她的押金，她被不公平地對待。
I told a white lie and said I loved the sweater.
我說了個善意的小謊，說我很喜歡那件毛衣。
Is it ever okay to tell a white lie to a friend?
對朋友說個善意的謊言，有時算可以嗎？
Don't be a wet blanket, come and dance with us.
別這麼掃興，來跟我們一起跳舞吧。
He was a wet blanket at the party and left early.
他在派對上很掃興，而且提早離開了。
Winning the prize is a long shot, but I will enter anyway.
要得獎機會很小，不過我還是要參加。
It was a long shot, but she asked her boss for a raise.
希望不大，但她還是向老闆要求加薪。

a pretty penny.zh: 一大筆錢,相當可觀的一筆錢
ai: That new phone must have cost a pretty penny.
那支新手機一定花了不少錢。
They paid a pretty penny for their house by the sea.
他們花了一大筆錢買下海邊那棟房子。
The old couple walked hand in hand along the beach.
那對老夫妻手牽著手沿著海灘散步。
The children crossed the street hand in hand with their teacher.
孩子們跟老師手牽著手過馬路。

hand in hand.zh: 密切相關、同時並進（go hand in hand）
ai: Good health and a good diet go hand in hand.
健康和良好的飲食是密不可分的。
In this company, hard work and rewards go hand in hand.
在這家公司，努力和回報是相輔相成的。
We talked heart to heart until midnight.
我們推心置腹地聊到半夜。
My father and I finally spoke heart to heart about my future.
我爸和我終於坦誠地談起我的未來。
I searched high and low for my keys.
我到處找我的鑰匙。
They looked high and low for a cheap apartment.
他們四處尋找便宜的公寓。

hit and miss.zh: 得失各佔一半,不管勝負如何,胡亂地
ai: The service at that café is hit and miss.
那家咖啡店的服務時好時壞。
My cooking is hit and miss, so don't expect too much.
我的廚藝時好時壞，所以別期待太高。
Finding a good seat at the concert is hit or miss.
在演唱會要找到好位子全憑運氣。
He studied in a hit or miss way and failed the test.
他讀書漫無章法，結果考試沒過。
Hot air rises, so the top floor is always warmer.
熱空氣會上升，所以頂樓總是比較熱。
The balloon floated up because it was filled with hot air.
氣球裡充滿熱空氣，所以飄了起來。
His speech was just hot air with no real plan.
他的演講只是空話，沒有任何實際計畫。
Don't believe him, he's full of hot air.
別信他，他只會吹牛。

in full swing.zh: 正在全力進行中, 活躍
ai: By nine o'clock, the party was in full swing.
到了九點，派對已經熱鬧到最高點。
The summer festival is in full swing downtown.
夏日慶典正在市中心熱烈舉行。
This result is in no way your fault.
這個結果絕對不是你的錯。
In no way am I trying to blame anyone.
我絕對不是想怪罪任何人。
The students stood up in turn and introduced themselves.
學生們依序站起來自我介紹。
We washed the dishes in turn after dinner.
晚餐後我們輪流洗碗。
Lower prices attract more customers, which in turn increases sales.
價格降低會吸引更多顧客，進而提高銷售量。
Stress affects sleep, and poor sleep in turn makes stress worse.
壓力會影響睡眠，而睡不好又反過來讓壓力更大。
The singer was not in tune with the piano.
那位歌手的音和鋼琴不合。
A good leader stays in tune with the needs of the team.
好的領導者會貼近團隊的需求。
Thanks for keeping it real and telling me the truth.
謝謝你坦白說真話，保持真誠。
Even after becoming famous, she kept it real with her fans.
就算成名了，她對粉絲依然保持真誠。
You can't change his mind, so just let it be.
你改變不了他的想法，就隨它去吧。
The room is messy, but let it be for now.
房間很亂，不過先別管它了。
Don't let go of the rope until I say so.
我沒說之前，千萬別放開繩子。
The child let go of his mother's hand and ran off.
那個孩子放開媽媽的手跑走了。

let go of.zh: 放下、釋懷（let go of the past）
ai: It took her years to let go of the past.
她花了好幾年才放下過去。
You need to let go of your anger and move on.
你得放下怒氣，向前走。
The kids like to make believe they are astronauts.
孩子們喜歡假裝自己是太空人。
They made believe the sofa was a boat.
他們假裝沙發是一艘船。

make do.zh: 將就著使用, 湊合著用
ai: We had no table, so we made do with boxes.
我們沒有桌子，只好用箱子湊合。
You'll have to make do with a small room this time.
這次你得將就住小房間了。
No offense, but I think your idea needs more work.
無意冒犯，但我覺得你的想法還需要多加琢磨。
No offense, but I'd rather walk than ride with you.
請別見怪，但我寧願走路也不想搭你的車。
You stayed up all night, so no wonder you're tired.
你熬了一整夜，難怪會累。
No wonder the restaurant is full; the food is great.
難怪這家餐廳客滿，食物真的很棒。
Will I lend you my car? Not a chance!
要我借你車？門都沒有！
There's not a chance we'll finish by tonight.
我們今晚絕對不可能做完。

not exactly.zh: （說反話時用）並不; 並沒有; （用於糾正某人說過的話）並非如此; 不完全是這樣
ai: Are you angry? Not exactly, just a little tired.
你生氣了嗎？也不完全是，只是有點累。
The test was not exactly easy, but I passed.
這次考試並不算簡單，但我過了。

now or never.zh: 勿失良機; 機不可失; 時不再來; 只在此刻
ai: It's now or never, so ask her out today.
機不可失，今天就約她出去吧。
The team knew it was now or never in the final game.
球隊知道最後一場比賽是只此一次的機會。

off the hook.zh: 脫身、擺脫責任（let sb off the hook）
ai: The teacher let him off the hook this time.
老師這次放過他了。
I'm off the hook now that Tom has agreed to drive.
湯姆答應開車，我就不用負責了。
The phone was off the hook, so nobody could call us.
電話沒掛好，所以沒人打得進來。
Someone left the receiver off the hook all night.
有人整晚都沒把話筒掛好。
The old barn was on fire when the firefighters arrived.
消防員抵達時，那間舊穀倉正在燃燒。
Quick, the kitchen is on fire!
快點，廚房著火了！

on fire.zh: 表現超好、手感發燙（口語）
ai: Our star player was on fire in the second half.
我們的明星球員在下半場手感超好。
The band was on fire last night.
那個樂團昨晚的表現超棒。

on hold.zh: 等著通電話; 暫緩; 推遲; 擱置
ai: The customer service agent put me on hold for ten minutes.
客服人員讓我在線上等了十分鐘。
Our trip is on hold until the weather gets better.
我們的旅行暫時擱置，等天氣變好再說。
His angry reaction was a bit over the top.
他生氣的反應有點太誇張了。
The wedding decorations were beautiful but over the top.
婚禮的布置很漂亮，但有點太過頭。

play it cool.zh: 抑制住感情, 做出冷靜的樣子
ai: He tried to play it cool when he saw his favorite singer.
他看到最愛的歌手時，努力裝出冷靜的樣子。
Just play it cool and don't let them see you're nervous.
保持冷靜，別讓他們看出你很緊張。
I'll play it safe and leave early because of the traffic.
我要穩一點，因為塞車所以提早出發。
Investors who play it safe usually earn less money.
求穩的投資人通常賺得比較少。

play the fool.zh: 幹蠢事, 演滑稽角色
ai: He likes to play the fool to make his friends laugh.
他喜歡裝傻逗朋友笑。
Stop playing the fool and help me clean up.
別再鬧了，過來幫我收拾。

right on.zh: 說得對、太好了（表示贊同，口語）
ai: You think we should leave early? Right on!
你覺得我們該早點走？說得太對了！
Right on, that was a great idea!
太棒了，那真是個好主意！

right on.zh: 正好、剛剛好（right on time 準時）
ai: The bus arrived right on time this morning.
公車今天早上準時到站。
The dinner was ready right on schedule.
晚餐正好準時準備好了。
Thanks for your help today, and see you tomorrow.
謝謝你今天的幫忙，明天見。
The teacher waved and said, "See you tomorrow, class!"
老師揮揮手說：「同學們，明天見！」

so to speak.zh: 可以這麼說, 打個譬喻說
ai: He is, so to speak, the heart of our team.
可以這麼說，他是我們團隊的核心。
We were in the same boat, so to speak.
打個比方，我們當時是同舟共濟。
It was great to see you. Take care!
很高興見到你，保重喔！
She hugged me and said, "Take care."
她抱了抱我說：「保重。」
Take care when you cross the busy street.
過那條車多的馬路時要小心。
Take care not to spill the hot soup.
小心別把熱湯灑出來。
Can you take care of my dog this weekend?
這個週末你可以幫我照顧我的狗嗎？
Don't worry, I'll take care of the bill.
別擔心，帳單我來處理。
Take heart, things will get better soon.
打起精神來，事情很快就會好轉。
The players took heart after scoring the first goal.
球員們在進了第一球後重拾信心。
After years of saving, they took the plunge and bought a house.
存了好幾年的錢後，他們終於下定決心買了房子。
I'm going to take the plunge and start my own business.
我打算放手一搏，自己創業。
You're holding the map upside down.
你把地圖拿反了。
The bat hung upside down from the branch.
蝙蝠倒掛在樹枝上。
The storm turned our travel plans upside down.
那場暴風雨把我們的旅行計畫弄得一團亂。
You can't come to the party? What a pity!
你不能來派對嗎？太可惜了！
What a pity that the museum is closed today.
博物館今天休館，真是太遺憾了。
What a shame that it rained on your birthday.
你生日那天下雨，真是太可惜了。
The movie was cancelled? What a shame!
電影取消了？真是太遺憾了！
I have a bunch of emails to answer today.
我今天有一堆電子郵件要回。
She bought a bunch of books at the sale.
她在特賣會買了一大堆書。
He gave her a bunch of red roses.
他送了她一束紅玫瑰。
We ate a bunch of grapes on the train.
我們在火車上吃了一串葡萄。

all in all.zh: 總而言之, 合計, 頭等重要的東西
ai: All in all, it was a very good trip.
總而言之，這是一趟很棒的旅行。
The food was a bit slow, but all in all we enjoyed dinner.
上菜有點慢，不過整體而言我們吃得很開心。
He talks as though he knows everything.
他說話的樣子好像什麼都懂。
It looks as though it will rain soon.
看起來好像快下雨了。
At first sight, the problem looked easy.
乍看之下，這個問題似乎很簡單。
The house seemed perfect at first sight.
這棟房子第一眼看起來很完美。

at first sight.zh: 一見鍾情（love at first sight）
ai: They fell in love at first sight.
他們一見鍾情。
Do you believe in love at first sight?
你相信一見鍾情嗎？
At present, we have no empty rooms.
目前我們沒有空房了。
The doctor is busy at present, so please wait.
醫生現在很忙，請稍等。
The winners were chosen at random.
得獎者是隨機抽出的。
She opened the book at random and started to read.
她隨手翻開書就開始讀。
Children are at risk when they play near the road.
孩子在馬路邊玩耍很危險。
Many jobs are at risk because of the new machines.
許多工作因為新機器而岌岌可危。
Before long, the sun came out again.
不久之後，太陽又出來了。
You will feel better before long.
你很快就會覺得好一點。

by mistake.zh: 不小心、誤（如 took it by mistake 拿錯）
ai: I took your umbrella by mistake.
我不小心拿錯了你的傘。
She sent the message to the wrong person by mistake.
她不小心把訊息傳給了錯的人。
The test was far from easy.
這次考試一點都不簡單。
Our hotel is far from the station.
我們的旅館離車站很遠。

in charge.zh: 負責、主管（be in charge of）
ai: Who is in charge of this project?
這個專案由誰負責？
The teacher left Anna in charge while she was away.
老師不在時，讓安娜負責管理。

in touch.zh: 保持聯絡（keep in touch、get in touch）
ai: Let's keep in touch after you move.
你搬家後我們要保持聯絡喔。
Please get in touch if you need any help.
如果需要幫忙，請與我聯絡。
A good manager stays in touch with what customers want.
好的經理會掌握顧客的需求。
She is in touch with what young people like.
他跟不上潮流，但她很了解年輕人的喜好。
Little by little, her English got better.
她的英文漸漸進步了。
We saved money little by little to buy a car.
我們一點一點存錢，準備買車。
We went to the market on foot.
我們步行去市場。
It takes about ten minutes to get there on foot.
走路去那裡大約要十分鐘。
The guests came into the room one by one.
客人一個接一個走進房間。
He read the names one by one.
他把名字一個一個唸出來。
She practiced the song over and over.
她把那首歌反覆練習了好多次。
I told him over and over, but he forgot.
我跟他說了一遍又一遍，他還是忘了。
Sorry, I can't talk now because I'm in a hurry.
抱歉，我現在趕時間不能聊。
He left his bag at home because he was in a hurry.
他因為匆匆忙忙，把包包忘在家裡。
Please move your bike, it's in the way.
請把你的腳踏車移開，它擋路了。
I tried to help, but I was only in the way.
我想幫忙，結果只是礙手礙腳。
You can use honey in place of sugar.
你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。
Ben went to the meeting in place of his boss.
班代替他的老闆去開會。
The little boy was in danger near the river.
那個小男孩在河邊有危險。
Many rare animals are in danger of disappearing.
許多稀有動物正面臨絕種的危機。
She was in love with her best friend.
她愛上了她最好的朋友。
He fell in love with the city at once.
他一下子就愛上了這座城市。
My father is traveling on business this week.
我爸爸這個星期出差。
She goes to Tokyo on business twice a year.
她每年因公去東京兩次。
The nurse was on duty all night.
那位護理師整晚都在值班。
Who is on duty at the front desk today?
今天誰在櫃檯值班？
The Smiths are on holiday in Spain.
史密斯一家正在西班牙度假。
I met my husband while I was on holiday.
我是在度假時認識我先生的。
The train drivers are on strike again.
火車司機又在罷工了。
Workers went on strike for better pay.
工人為了爭取更好的薪水而罷工。

on second thought.zh: 進一步考慮後,重新思考後,轉念一想
ai: On second thought, I'll have tea instead of coffee.
轉念一想，我還是點茶不點咖啡好了。
I was going to say yes, but on second thought, I need time.
我本來要答應，但再想想，我需要一些時間。
Keep the medicine out of reach of children.
藥品要放在小孩拿不到的地方。
The book on the top shelf was out of reach.
最上層架子上的書我搆不到。
He was out of breath after running up the stairs.
他跑上樓梯後上氣不接下氣。
I get out of breath very easily these days.
我最近很容易喘不過氣。
I felt out of place in my old jeans at the fancy dinner.
穿著舊牛仔褲出席高級晚宴，我覺得很格格不入。
His loud jokes seemed out of place at the funeral.
他大聲說笑話在葬禮上顯得很不合宜。
Everything in the room looked out of place.
房間裡的東西看起來都不在原位。
One book on the shelf was out of place.
書架上有一本書放錯位置了。
I'll be up front with you: I don't like the plan.
我老實告訴你：我不喜歡這個計畫。
She was up front about her mistakes.
她坦白承認了自己的錯誤。
The company asked us to pay half the cost up front.
公司要我們先付一半的費用。
You must pay up front to book a room.
訂房必須先付款。
I like to sit up front on the bus.
我喜歡坐在公車的最前面。
The tall students stood up front for the photo.
高個子的學生站在最前面拍照。
The new bridge is still under construction.
那座新橋還在興建中。
Our road is under construction, so traffic is slow.
我們這條路正在施工，所以車流很慢。

for fear of.zh: 害怕,恐怕,生怕,唯恐,以防
ai: He kept quiet for fear of making things worse.
他唯恐把事情弄得更糟，所以保持沉默。
She took an umbrella for fear of rain.
她怕下雨，所以帶了把傘。
To begin with, we need a bigger table.
首先，我們需要一張更大的桌子。
There are many reasons. To begin with, it costs too much.
原因有很多。第一，它太貴了。
To begin with, I didn't like my new job.
起初我並不喜歡我的新工作。
The plan seemed simple to begin with.
這個計畫一開始看起來很簡單。
The car is old, not to mention very slow.
這輛車很舊，更別提還很慢。
He speaks French, not to mention Spanish and German.
他會說法文，西班牙文和德文就更不用說了。

at hand.zh: 在手邊, 在附近, 即將到來
ai: Keep your phone at hand in case I call.
把手機放在手邊，以防我打給你。
The exam is at hand, so I must study.
考試快到了，我得念書。
No matter how hard I try, I can't open this jar.
不管我怎麼用力，就是打不開這個罐子。
No matter how tired she was, she finished the work.
不管她多累，她還是把工作做完了。
We can walk or take a taxi; either way, we'll be late.
我們可以走路或搭計程車，反正都會遲到。
Either way, I'm happy with the result.
不管怎樣，我對結果都很滿意。

better off.zh: （那樣做）會比較好、處境更好（be better off）
ai: You would be better off staying home today.
你今天待在家裡會比較好。
He was better off before he changed jobs.
他換工作之前過得比較好。
Her family is better off than ours.
她家比我們家富裕。
People are better off now than they were ten years ago.
人們現在比十年前富裕。

may as well.zh: 還是...好, 還不如, 不妨
ai: The bus is late, so we may as well walk.
公車誤點了，我們不如走路吧。
You may as well tell me the truth now.
你現在不妨就告訴我實話。
My sister was keen on dancing as a child.
我姊姊小時候很喜歡跳舞。
My brother was keen on the idea of a picnic.
他們對野餐這個點子很有興趣。
She was capable of running a marathon.
她有能力跑完一場馬拉松。
This new machine was capable of doing the job faster.
電腦能夠更快完成這項工作。
Please pay attention to the teacher's instructions.
請注意聽老師的指示。
He never pays attention to the weather report.
他從來不注意天氣預報。

talk over.zh: 商量, 討論, 說服
ai: Let's talk over the plan at lunch.
我們午餐時一起討論這個計畫吧。
They talked over the problem for hours.
他們討論那個問題討論了好幾個小時。

talk over.zh: 以口才使改變立場, 商量, 討論
ai: The couple talked over their budget before buying the sofa.
這對夫妻在買沙發前先商量了預算。
I need to talk over this offer with my family.
我需要和家人討論這個提議。
Please think over my offer before you answer.
回答前請你仔細考慮我的提議。
She thought over the job for a week.
她把這份工作考慮了一個星期。

turn around.zh: （使）轉身; （使）好轉; 改變意見; 使變得完全不同
ai: He turned around and waved at us.
他轉過身來對我們揮手。
The new manager turned around the failing company.
新經理讓這家快倒的公司轉虧為盈。
Please turn around and look at the board.
請轉過身來看黑板。
The factory laid off fifty workers last month.
那間工廠上個月裁了五十名員工。
Many companies may lay off staff this year.
許多公司今年可能會裁員。
Lay off me, I'm trying to study.
別煩我了，我正在念書。
Just lay off him, he said he was sorry.
別再找他麻煩了，他說過他很抱歉。
The doctor told him to lay off salty food.
醫生叫他少吃鹹的食物。
I'm going to lay off coffee for a month.
我打算有一個月不喝咖啡。
It turned out that he was my neighbor.
結果他原來是我的鄰居。
The cake turned out better than I expected.
蛋糕做出來比我預期的還好。
Please turn out the lights when you leave.
離開時請把燈關掉。
He turned out the lamp and went to sleep.
他關掉檯燈去睡覺了。
Thousands of fans turned out for the parade.
成千上萬的球迷到場參加遊行。
Not many people turn out for the meetings.
沒有多少人會來參加那些會議。
The factory turns out two hundred chairs a day.
這家工廠一天生產兩百張椅子。
The school has turned out many great musicians.
這所學校培養出許多優秀的音樂家。
